command:
set -eo pipefail
export OMPI_MCA_rmaps_base_oversubscribe=yes OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 HOME=/tmp XDG_CACHE_HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp
echo '== FEniCSx Poisson MMS: patch test + convergence order, 2 MPI ranks =='
cat > recipe.py <<'PYEOF'
from mpi4py import MPI
import numpy as np, ufl, dolfinx, sys
from dolfinx import mesh, fem
from dolfinx.fem.petsc import LinearProblem
comm = MPI.COMM_WORLD

def solve(N, degree, exact_fn):
    dom = mesh.create_unit_square(comm, N, N)
    V = fem.functionspace(dom, ("Lagrange", degree))
    x = ufl.SpatialCoordinate(dom)
    ue = exact_fn(x)
    f = -ufl.div(ufl.grad(ue))
    uD = fem.Function(V)
    uD.interpolate(fem.Expression(ue, V.element.interpolation_points))
    td = dom.topology.dim
    dom.topology.create_connectivity(td-1, td)
    facets = mesh.exterior_facet_indices(dom.topology)
    dofs = fem.locate_dofs_topological(V, td-1, facets)
    bc = fem.dirichletbc(uD, dofs)
    u, v = ufl.TrialFunction(V), ufl.TestFunction(V)
    a = ufl.inner(ufl.grad(u), ufl.grad(v))*ufl.dx
    L = f*v*ufl.dx
    uh = LinearProblem(a, L, bcs=[bc], petsc_options_prefix="mms_",
        petsc_options={"ksp_type":"preonly","pc_type":"lu"}).solve()
    err = fem.form(ufl.inner(uh-ue, uh-ue)*ufl.dx)
    return np.sqrt(comm.allreduce(fem.assemble_scalar(err), op=MPI.SUM))

quad = lambda x: 1 + x[0] + 2*x[1] + 3*x[0]**2 + 4*x[0]*x[1] + 5*x[1]**2
e_patch = solve(16, 2, quad)
sinsol = lambda x: ufl.sin(ufl.pi*x[0])*ufl.sin(ufl.pi*x[1])
Ns=[8,16,32,64]; errs=[solve(N,2,sinsol) for N in Ns]
rates=[float(np.log(errs[i-1]/errs[i])/np.log(2)) for i in range(1,len(errs))]

if comm.rank==0:
    lines=[f"dolfinx {dolfinx.__version__}  |  P2 Lagrange, Poisson via method of manufactured solutions"]
    fail=[]
    def chk(label,ok,detail):
        line=f"{label:22s} {detail}  [{'ok' if ok else 'FAIL'}]"; print(line); lines.append(line)
        if not ok: fail.append(label)
    chk("mpi_ranks", comm.size==2, f"{comm.size} want 2 (parallel dolfinx)")
    chk("patch_test_exact", e_patch<1e-10, f"L2={e_patch:.2e} want <1e-10 (P2 reproduces a quadratic exactly)")
    chk("convergence_rate", all(2.7<r<3.3 for r in rates), f"rates={[round(r,2) for r in rates]} want ~3.0 (L2 ~ h^(p+1), p=2)")
    chk("error_decreases", errs[-1]<errs[0]<1e-2, f"L2 {errs[0]:.2e} -> {errs[-1]:.2e} over N {Ns[0]}..{Ns[-1]}")
    lines.append("SMOKE CHECK PASSED" if not fail else "SMOKE CHECK FAILED "+str(fail))
    for N,e in zip(Ns,errs): lines.append(f"  N={N:3d}  L2={e:.4e}")
    open('smoke-check.txt','w').write("\n".join(lines)+"\n")
    print("SMOKE CHECK PASSED" if not fail else "SMOKE CHECK FAILED")
    sys.exit(1 if fail else 0)

PYEOF
mpirun --allow-run-as-root -n 2 python3 recipe.py
